bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
test -d "$root" || exit 61
cd "$root"
echo PROJECT=TGtumbler
echo ACTION=COMMON_MENU_MAPPING_READ_ONLY
echo HOST_GIT_HEAD="$(git rev-parse --short=12 HEAD)"
for file in artifacts/bot/src/bot/{recruitmentHandlers,roomHandlers,profileCompactHandlers,postingHandlers,searchHandlers,operationHelpHandlers,bugReportHandlers}.ts; do
 test -f "$file" || { echo MISSING_HANDLER="$(basename "$file")"; continue; }
 echo HANDLER="$(basename "$file")"
done
for name in bareStartPostingExtra showWizardScreen commonGateUrl currentMenuOrigin currentTopicDmEntry; do
 count="$(grep -rlF "$name" artifacts/bot/src/{bot,services} --include='*.ts' | wc -l)"
 echo "COMMON_REFERENCES_$name=$count"
done
echo UI_LAYOUT_OWNER=artifacts/bot/src/services/menuPanelRenderer.ts
echo TOPIC_OWNER=artifacts/bot/src/services/topicRouting.ts
echo DM_RUNTIME_OWNER=artifacts/bot/src/gaybbsBot.ts
echo ACTION_END=COMMON_MENU_MAPPING_READ_ONLY
